## Why visit

The outstanding reason to come is the old snug: settles gathered around a table and substantial fireplace, inside a thatched, timber-framed building. It offers a more intimate rural counterpoint to the grand city interiors and is worth considering for pub-history enthusiasts prepared to organise transport. There is also a restaurant in the former cowshed, making a longer meal visit possible. Beer selection needs an unusually careful question here because CAMRA identifies both genuine cask choices and a brewery-conditioned beer using a handpump.

## Beer

CAMRA lists cask options including Brimstage and Timothy Taylor, but explicitly warns that Wainwright Amber here is brewery-conditioned keg through a handpump, not cask.
